EV100 normalises to ISO 100 so exposures across sensitivities can be compared; a difference of 1 EV corresponds to a doubling of light. Scene brightness is graded by EV100 (snow at noon >=16, the sunny 16 rule about 14, overcast about 12, night <=2).
